title: Cartwise+ Membership Anniversary Offer by Enrollment Length
content:
An anniversary offer, taken off the charge when a Cartwise+ Membership member moves up from a monthly plan to Cartwise+ Annual, follows the enrollment date.

| Enrollment date on the membership record | Offer taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| at least 36 months back | 1.00 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 36 months back | 0.50 |
| fewer than 24 months back | 0.00 |

Months are whole months counted from the enrollment date up to today; a month is whole on the same day of the month as the enrollment date.

## Hypothetical boundary cases (today 20 April)

| Enrolled | Whole months back | Offer |
|---|---|---|
| 20 April three years earlier | 36 | 1.00 |
| 21 April three years earlier | 35 | 0.50 |
| 20 April two years earlier | 24 | 0.50 |
| 21 April two years earlier | 23 | 0.00 |
